selection_time: after all predeclared Stage A runs; before any Stage B run
selection_inputs: held-out noisy-label Value and Gradient Actor fit
rationale: TA_A improved both seeds, had the largest mean paired improvement, the lowest held-out Value error, nearly the lowest held-out Gradient error, no terminal-domain saturation, and 2.29x the improvement per attributed GPU minute of A. It also outperformed the 8192-point standard Actor B at 54% of B's attributed compute. Wider Actors C and D did not improve their matched-width-192 controls, so capacity expansion was not selected. TA_B was not run because the smaller terminal-aware fix already exceeded the high-data standard Actor; combining fixes was not needed to identify the smallest justified intervention.
